annotations.title: Live Companies House check of a subcontractor's company

description: UK only. Call this FIRST when a subcontractor gives a company name or number: it looks the company up live on the Companies House register and returns its status (active, dissolved, in liquidation), company type, date of incorporation, registered office, nature of business, active directors, and whether accounts or the confirmation statement are overdue, with a link. It also says which work_arrangement to pass to check_subcontractor_right_to_work_duty. Give company_number (8 characters, for example 01234567 or SC123456) or name. Free.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 01234567 or SC123456.

name.description: Company name, if the number is not known. Up to 5 matches are returned.
